svg.title: SEL at the 74HCT132's input
svg.desc: An ABT273 on the backplane drives SEL through its series resistor and 200 mm of trace to one 74HCT132 input on the card; fast corner. VT± is the gate's VT+ minimum and VT− maximum at 5.5 V, the level ring-back must not recross.
svg.text: ns from the input crossing 1.5 V
ns from the input crossing 1.5 V
